title: Workflow AI Budget Envelope v1
description: Normative typed, immutable, provider-neutral AI-budget member of one immutable WorkflowDefinitionVersion. The Workflow Engine durably snapshots this exact value when it accepts the Workflow; this schema creates no identity and no accounting ledger.

ContractVersion.description: The complete interpretation version of this envelope. Unknown versions are rejected before an AI-capable step is dispatched.

WorkflowDefinitionVersionId.description: The exact immutable Workflow Definition version that contains this envelope.

PolicyId.description: The existing logical Policy identity governing this envelope; it is not a budget identity.

PolicyVersionId.description: The exact immutable Policy Version that authorizes the ceiling and admission semantics.

TenantId.description: The exact Tenant scope; it must match the accepted Workflow and Gateway accounting allocation.

WorkspaceId.description: The exact Workspace scope; it must match the accepted Workflow and Gateway accounting allocation.

Amount.description: Positive base-10 decimal normalized cost ceiling. Floating-point values, negative amounts, zero, and an implicit unlimited amount are not valid.

CurrencyOrReferenceUnit.description: The controlled normalized currency or reference unit used by AI Gateway ActualCost, EstimatedCost, reservations, and reconciliation for this Workflow allocation.

$comment: This is a Workflow Definition/policy member, not Command metadata, a PolicyRef-only selector, an identity, a result reference, an idempotency key, or a Gateway-owned cost record. The accepted Workflow stores the exact validated member with its WorkflowId as durable admission/audit evidence.
